Most Protective tier: public-accommodations and employment protections, gender-identity hate crime, shield law, no bathroom ban. National border and custody exposure still apply.
Restrictive state layered on hostile national regime: minor care ban, prison care denial, surgery-based document rules, no gender-identity nondiscrimination; hate-crime coverage only partial offset.

Among harshest for adults: 2026 ID-marker ban, anti-trans executive order, pending bathroom/prison bill; no statewide gender-identity nondiscrimination. Current bathroom use unprotected statewide but not banned.

Low-risk state: gender-identity protections in employment, housing, public accommodations, hate crime, panic-defence repeal, accessible markers. Youth/school restrictions and national border exposure remain.
